title: Kloosterman sign changes with moduli having at most five prime factors
summary: On square-free moduli $q\in(X,2X]$ having at most five prime factors, we prove that each sign of the normalized Kloosterman sum $\operatorname{Kl}(1;q)$ occurs $\gg X/\log X$ times. This improves the recent unconditional result of Zhang and Zhong for moduli with at most six prime factors. Building on their analytic estimates and optimized Selberg sieve, we replace their truncated divisor penalty by a geometric half-weight.
